name: LeetCode Practice
description: Sign in to your LeetCode (leetcode.cn) account in the DBX plugin center to browse the problem library, view problem statements, choose a language, write code, and run or submit for judging.
releaseNotes: 0.2.1 修复两个 issue：#1 会员/内容为空的题目不再空白，改为明确提示 + 重试；#2 代码编辑器新增自实现语法高亮（按语言切换、行号、Tab/回车缩进）。延续 0.2.0：免粘贴浏览器登录（受控 Chrome/Edge + DevTools 取回，start+poll 规避 30s 超时）、isSignedIn 校验修复、题面字段归一化、昵称显示、分页、题面/代码可拖动分隔与做题页全屏。
